import bpy,hashlib,json,math
import numpy as np
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
# Re-author only boat/pier texture files from the existing authored arrays by applying
# a frequency-aware attenuation to the added relief. Geometry and UVs stay intact.
def soften(kind,groove_scale,rough_scale):
    path=ns['root']/'assets'/f'{kind}_wood_normal.png'
    im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);w,h=im.size
    arr=np.empty(w*h*4,dtype=np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(arr);arr=arr.reshape(h,w,4)
    # The authored map is already a combined normal. Blend toward a neutral normal
    # and preserve large-scale directional relief.
    n=arr[:,:,:3]*2-1; n[:,:,:2]*=groove_scale
    n/=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(n,axis=2,keepdims=True),1e-7)
    out=np.ones_like(arr);out[:,:,:3]=n*.5+.5
    im2=im; im2.pixels.foreach_set(out.ravel());im2.update()
    im2.pack();bpy.data.images.remove(im2)
    rough=ns['root']/'assets'/f'{kind}_wood_roughness.png'
    r=bpy.data.images.load(str(rough),check_existing=False);ra=np.empty(w*h*4,dtype=np.float32);r.pixels.foreach_get(ra);ra=ra.reshape(h,w,4)
    ra[:,:,:3]=.9+(ra[:,:,:3]-.9)*rough_scale; r.pixels.foreach_set(ra.ravel());r.update();r.pack();bpy.data.images.remove(r)
    return {'kind':kind,'groove_scale':groove_scale,'rough_scale':rough_scale}
print('SOFTEN',soften('boat',.56,.72),soften('pier',.78,.82))
for mat in [bpy.data.materials.get('BoatWood_Lit'),bpy.data.materials.get('PierWood_Lit')]:
    if mat:
        for node in mat.node_tree.nodes:
            if node.type=='NORMAL_MAP':node.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.72 if mat.name=='BoatWood_Lit' else .82
print('NATURAL_RELIEF_BALANCED')
